declared_scope: The v0.12 parent stack plus a single reversible sysctl: vm.dirty_expire_centisecs=1500 (channel: memory). Autonomously proposed; one knob added, nothing removed.
hypothesis: Expiring dirty pages sooner (3000->1500 cs) smooths writeback bursts that can interfere with reclaim under pressure. Expect memory channel neutral-to-better, sustained neutral.
rollback_method: Restores the prior vm.dirty_expire_centisecs value captured at apply time, then delegates the rest of the revert to the v0.12 preset undo; harness reverts at run end.
